item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena is helping her teacher prepare a chart on reproduction for the school science exhibition in Jaipur. For the chart, she must state where the male and female gametes are found in a flowering plant. Which statement should she write?

options.A: Male gametes are in the ovules and female gametes are in the pollen grains.
options.B: Male gametes are in the pollen grains inside the anther and female gametes are in the ovules inside the flower.
options.C: Both male and female gametes are in the petals of the flower.
options.D: Male gametes are in the roots and female gametes are in the leaves.
